title: European Market Launch
tagline: Zero to live in 6 weeks with full B2B automation
summary: A resin brand needed to launch a multi-language, multi-currency store for the European market with a B2B wholesale portal — from zero to live in 1.5 months.
challenge: The company had no European e-commerce presence, no localized payment or currency handling, and no B2B ordering system. All wholesale orders were processed manually via email and spreadsheets, creating delays and errors.
solution: I built a complex Shopify architecture supporting multiple languages and currencies, with a dedicated B2B wholesale portal for bulk ordering. I created a centralized PIM (Product Information Management) catalog so product data stayed consistent across channels, and automated key processes — order routing, customer notifications, and inventory sync — using n8n, Bitrix24 CRM, and WhatsApp Business API.
results: Launched in 6 weeks, from architecture to go-live
Fully automated order processing — zero manual entry
B2B wholesale portal reduced order errors by eliminating manual spreadsheet work
Automated customer retention flows via WhatsApp and CRM

title: Operational Platform for Real Estate Business
tagline: Cut manual work by 60% across all departments
summary: A fast-growing real estate operations company was drowning in disconnected spreadsheets, manual approvals, and siloed departments with no shared visibility into deals, finance, or logistics.
challenge: Every department — sales, finance, logistics — worked from separate files with no single source of truth. Deals fell through cracks, approvals took days, and leadership had no real-time view of company performance.
solution: I designed and deployed a unified operational platform connecting all departments into one system, with automated approval workflows, real-time dashboards, and standardized processes across the company.
results: Reduced manual work by 60% through automation
Unified operational visibility across sales, finance, and logistics
Streamlined supply chain and inventory management

title: Scaling Marketplace Revenue 3.5x
summary: EmEx Group needed to scale commercial operations across multiple online marketplaces while managing a rapidly growing product catalog and team.
challenge: The company was managing an 8,000+ SKU catalog across multiple marketplace channels with inconsistent processes, limited team structure, and untapped revenue potential on key platforms.
solution: I restructured the commercial strategy, built out a 50-person team across sales, operations, and logistics, and implemented systematic processes for catalog management, pricing, and channel expansion.
results: Scaled marketplace revenue by 3.5x in 12 months
Managed and organized a product matrix of 8,000+ SKUs
Built and led a team of 50+ across sales, operations, and logistics

title: Building B2B Operations From Scratch
tagline: From startup to €500K+ annual wholesale revenue
summary: TOP SPORTS needed to build a B2B wholesale channel from the ground up, including supplier relationships across Asia and a centralized procurement system.
challenge: No existing B2B channel, no centralized supplier management, and no systematic procurement process — everything was ad hoc and relationship-dependent.
solution: I built the B2B wholesale channel from zero, established supply chain relationships with 8 factories across Asia, and implemented a centralized procurement and inventory system to support consistent growth.
results: Grew wholesale channel from startup to €500K+ annual revenue
Managed supply chain across 8 factories in Asia
Implemented centralized procurement and inventory system
